# Rawafid

> Rawafid (rawafid.tech) is a web agency that designs and builds websites, mobile apps, and e-commerce stores, backed by SEO and digital marketing. We work remotely with clients across Asia and worldwide. Contact: hello@rawafid.tech

## What we do

- [Web design & development](https://rawafid.tech/#services): Custom websites and web apps designed around your goals, built on modern foundations, and fast on every device.
- [Mobile apps](https://rawafid.tech/#services): iOS and Android apps that feel native, stay maintainable, and ship without drama.
- [E-commerce](https://rawafid.tech/#services): Online stores where browsing is pleasant and checkout is effortless, from product page to payment.
- [SEO & digital marketing](https://rawafid.tech/#services): Technical SEO, content strategy, and paid campaigns after launch.

## Projects

- [Terra](https://rawafid.tech/projects/terra): E-commerce store for an organic skincare brand.
- [Atlas Kitchen](https://rawafid.tech/projects/atlas-kitchen): Website and online reservations for a Mediterranean restaurant.
- [Sanad](https://rawafid.tech/projects/sanad): Mobile banking app for iOS and Android.
- [Dar Nour](https://rawafid.tech/projects/dar-nour): Direct booking site for a boutique riad.

## How we work

- [Process](https://rawafid.tech/#process): Listen, design, build, then launch and grow. Fixed price per project, agreed upfront. Projects run remotely over email and video calls with shared previews at every stage.
- [FAQ](https://rawafid.tech/#faq): Typical marketing sites take four to eight weeks. We can also take over and improve existing websites. After launch, clients can self-manage or keep us on for maintenance, SEO, and marketing.
